runs.scope: shadcn component audit, stable tables, affiliate preview, and compact hero
changes: Resource listings compose the installed shadcn Table, TableHeader, TableBody, TableRow, TableHead, TableCell and TableCaption; no nested vertical scroll.
Consistent row heights and aria-hidden empty rows preserve full-page table height on the last page; pagination keeps a fixed number of slots.
Resource actions use Button; pagination uses Pagination/Content/Item/Ellipsis; Select options are inside SelectGroup.
Category filters use ToggleGroup; searches use InputGroup; loading states use Skeleton; empty and error states use Empty.
Submission fields use FieldGroup/Field/FieldLabel; feedback uses Alert, Avatar and Spinner; bookmark clearing uses AlertDialog.
Desktop navigation uses NavigationMenu. Mobile Sheet has an accessible description. Root html declares smooth scrolling for Next.js 16.
Affiliate mockups use Card and Item with two explicitly labelled Preview entries and null URLs; real links can be supplied through src/lib/affiliates.ts.

Final hero is one compact masthead: sunglasses logo, wordmark, one sentence, browse action and existing submission action. Sidebar category card and commercial blocks were removed from the hero at the user request.
Sponsors and affiliate previews accompany the catalogue; mobile affiliate previews sit below the results. Credits remain in the footer.
